digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler CLI and engine interfaces
propositions: Make bridge preview/sync the primary canonical CLI vocabulary while preserving legacy reconcile entrypoints as explicit compatibility adapters with different defaults and filtering semantics
Legacy reconcile remains dry-run by default; bridge sync remains live; argument-less legacy reconcile and direct-engine calls retain their documented modes and numeric behaviors
Canonical --only/--except filters narrow differ inputs before execution; legacy --filter-local-ids retains post-differ write filtering; both selection paths normalize into shared core execution
Invalid, unresolved, or disappeared selection tokens exit 2 before lock acquisition without calling differ, applier, manifest, or persistence seams
Explicit --max-changes caps apply deterministic partitions with deterministic applied/deferred manifests; uncapped live removes its temporary manifest; invalid/zero/negative caps exit 2 before lock

Public Python rebar.reconcile() and MCP reconcile tool remain callable with historical defaults and gating behavior; production workflow retains reconcile-check diagnostic path while mapping other modes to canonical vocabulary
